title: Maximal inequalities and the decay of Fourier transforms of measures
summary: It is shown that Schrödinger maximal inequalities over fractals are equivalent to the $L^2$ decay rates of Fourier transforms of fractal measures over the paraboloid. A similar connection is shown between the wave equation and cone averages. One implication is well-known and follows from the Kolmogorov-Seliverstov-Plessner method, but the other implication is nontrivial and relies on a variant of the Marstrand projection theorem.
